ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pigmentation with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution concentrated in focal spots and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across the macro surface; distinct high-contrast white circular spots scattered across both lobes; high-density white/textured clusters at distal tips (coordinates: extreme lateral edges).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a deep vertical-to-horizontal bounding ratio; vertex is sharp with no visible rounding.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the mid-section of the trailing edge; transitioning to high-amplitude, jagged topography at the distal lobe tips due to biological protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature originating from the central notch and sweeping upward towards the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel groups located at the far lateral tips of both the left and right lobes; scattered individual white focal points across the central ventral area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned thin white linear disruptions; prominent vertical mark in the lower-mid region of the left lobe and diagonal marks in the upper-mid region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips creating a highly irregular, jagged silhouette; presence of multiple linear rake marks across the fluke surface.
